description: Flat metadata schema for transmission electron microscopy images of genetically modified plant cells with immunogold labeling of tagged proteins, including sample preparation, embedding/sectioning, imaging settings, and plant genetic/phenotypic context.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the TEM image or metadata record.

specimen_id.descr: Unique identifier linking the image to the biological specimen or tissue block.

experiment_id.descr: Identifier for the TEM experiment or study batch.

species.descr: Plant species used (e.g., Arabidopsis thaliana, Nicotiana benthamiana).

cultivar_or_ecotype.descr: Cultivar, ecotype, or accession of the plant line.

plant_line_name.descr: Name/code of the genetically modified plant line.

genetic_background.descr: Genetic background or parental line used for transformation/breeding.

transgene_name.descr: Name of the introduced gene/protein of interest.

protein_of_interest_tag.descr: Epitope or fluorescent tag fused to the protein of interest (e.g., HA, FLAG, GFP), or 'none' if untagged.

tag_location.descr: Tag position on the protein, such as N-terminal, C-terminal, internal, or none.

promoter_name.descr: Promoter controlling transgene expression, if applicable.

transformation_method.descr: Method used to generate the line (e.g., Agrobacterium-mediated transformation, CRISPR editing, stable crossing).

zygocity_or_copy_state.descr: Transgene zygosity or copy-state description (e.g., homozygous, heterozygous, single-copy).

selection_marker.descr: Selectable marker used to obtain the line, if any.

phenotype_description.descr: Observed phenotype relevant to the study, such as photosynthetic efficiency changes, chlorosis, growth defect, or stress tolerance.

stress_condition.descr: Stress treatment applied to the plant prior to fixation, if any (e.g., drought, high light, salt, cold).

stress_severity.descr: Quantitative or categorical severity of the stress condition, if available.

tissue_type.descr: Plant tissue analyzed (e.g., leaf mesophyll, guard cell, root, seedling cotyledon).

cell_type_or_subcellular_context.descr: Specific cell type or cellular context examined.

developmental_stage.descr: Developmental stage of the plant or tissue at sampling.

sample_collection_date.descr: Date when the specimen was collected or fixed.

fixation_method.descr: Primary fixation method used for TEM sample preservation.

primary_fixative.descr: Primary fixative composition, such as glutaraldehyde concentration or formaldehyde mixture.

secondary_fixative.descr: Secondary fixative used, such as osmium tetroxide, potassium ferrocyanide, or none.

fixation_temperature_c.descr: Temperature during fixation in degrees Celsius.

buffer_composition.descr: Buffer used during fixation and washes, including pH if relevant.

dehydration_series.descr: Description of dehydration solvents and steps, such as ethanol or acetone series.

embedding_resin.descr: Embedding medium or resin used (e.g., Spurr's resin, LR White, Epon).

embedding_protocol.descr: Brief description of embedding protocol, including infiltration conditions if important.

section_orientation.descr: Orientation of sectioning relative to tissue or organelle structure (e.g., transverse, longitudinal, serial).

grid_type.descr: TEM grid type and support film, if applicable.

poststain_method.descr: Post-staining method used (e.g., uranyl acetate, lead citrate, none).

primary_antibody_target.descr: Target recognized by the primary antibody, such as the protein tag or endogenous protein.

primary_antibody_host.descr: Host species in which the primary antibody was raised.

primary_antibody_catalog_or_id.descr: Catalog number, clone ID, or internal identifier for the primary antibody.

primary_antibody_dilution.descr: Dilution used for the primary antibody, expressed as a string such as 1:100.

secondary_antibody_host.descr: Host species targeted by the secondary antibody.

secondary_antibody_gold_size_nm.descr: Diameter of the colloidal gold particle in nanometers.

immunolabeling_blocking_solution.descr: Blocking solution used before antibody incubation.

immunolabeling_incubation_time_h.descr: Primary antibody incubation time in hours.

immunolabeling_temperature_c.descr: Temperature during immunolabeling in degrees Celsius.

wash_buffer.descr: Buffer used for washing after antibody incubations.

image_id.descr: Unique identifier for the TEM image file.

image_file_name.descr: Image file name or storage key.

image_acquisition_date.descr: Date the TEM image was acquired.

emission_source.descr: Electron source type, such as tungsten, LaB6, or field emission gun.

camera_or_detector_model.descr: Camera or detector model used for image capture.

pixel_size_nm.descr: Pixel size at specimen level in nanometers per pixel.

image_bit_depth.descr: Bit depth of the acquired image.

exposure_time_ms.descr: Exposure time in milliseconds, if recorded by the system.

defocus_nm.descr: Defocus value in nanometers, if known.

objective_aperture_size.descr: Objective aperture size or setting, if used.

scale_bar_length_nm.descr: Length represented by the scale bar in nanometers.

scale_bar_present.descr: Whether a scale bar is present in the image.

image_format.descr: Stored image format, such as TIFF, DM4, or MRC.

file_checksum.descr: Checksum for file integrity verification, such as MD5 or SHA-256 digest.

subcellular_structure_targeted.descr: Organelle or subcellular structure of interest, such as chloroplast, mitochondrion, nucleus, or plasma membrane.

gold_particle_count.descr: Count of immunogold particles observed in the scored field or region.

gold_particle_density_per_um2.descr: Immunogold particle density normalized per square micrometer, if calculated.

image_region_of_interest.descr: Description of the imaged region within the cell or tissue block.

analysis_notes.descr: Free-text notes on image interpretation, anomalies, or acquisition caveats.
